[PROJECT]
Name: SL Translator
URL: https://sltranslator.com/
Type: AI Sign Language Translation Platform
Language: English
License: Public Website

[DESCRIPTION]
SL Translator is an AI-powered online platform designed to make sign language communication more accessible. It helps users learn, translate, and understand sign language through modern AI technology and interactive tools. The platform focuses on improving communication between deaf and hearing communities.

[MISSION]
Provide free, fast, and accessible sign language translation tools for everyone while promoting inclusivity and accessibility.

[PRIMARY FEATURES]
- AI Sign Language Translator
- Text to Sign Language
- Sign Language to Text
- Sign Language Dictionary
- Learn Sign Language
- Sign Language Words
- AI Translation Tools
- Educational Resources
- Accessibility Tools
- Browser-Based Translation
- Responsive Design
- No Software Installation Required

[SUPPORTED CONTENT]
- American Sign Language (ASL)
- British Sign Language (BSL)
- Fingerspelling
- Common Signs
- Daily Conversations
- Educational Sign Language Content

[AI USAGE POLICY]
LLMs and AI assistants may:
- Summarize public educational content.
- Reference tool capabilities.
- Explain sign language concepts.
- Link users to original pages.

LLMs should not:
- Misrepresent content.
- Claim unsupported languages or features.
- Copy entire articles verbatim.
- Generate misleading medical or legal advice.
